content.text: The Lumen Bottle keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours. It is made from 90% recycled steel. Lumen was founded in 2015.

references.title: Lumen Bottle Product Specification
references.text: Lumen Bottle Product Specification. Insulation: keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours and hot for up to 12 hours. Body: 18/8 stainless steel with 70% recycled content.
